I can't give you a tree-cover change status for ASSET-K. The analysis did not produce any result.

The land-change run (run-1, 12 Nov 2026) was set up with a 31 Dec 2020 baseline, a 30% tree-cover threshold and a 0.5 ha minimum event size. The zonal statistics step then failed with this message: "the source coverage this asset needs has not been prepared; no observation was made." So there are no loss figures, event counts or corroboration results. The asset's area is also missing (null).

This is not evidence of "no change." The run simply never observed the asset, so nothing can be said either way.

The next step is to have the source coverage for this asset prepared, then rerun the analysis. Until that happens, any statement about tree-cover loss or stability for ASSET-K would be unsupported. Note too that the engine is labeled early access.
